certificate.module_name: Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8 NSS Cryptographic Module
certificate.caveat: When operated in approved mode and installed, initialized and configured as specified in Section 11 of the Security Policy. No assurance of minimum security of SSPs (e.g., keys, bit strings) that are externally loaded, or of SSPs established with externally loaded SSPs. The module generates random numbers whose strengths are modified by available entropy.
certificate.description: Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8 NSS Cryptographic Module consists of the Softoken and Freebl libraries offering various cryptographic mechanisms.
